evidence: Matches the 'Validation' label and modifies chainstate startup verification logic (`verifychain` and undo data handling).
rationale: Fixes a false database corruption abort during startup verification when pruned blocks are refetched without undo data. When users refetch pruned blocks with `getblockfrompeer`, deep startup verification (`checklevel > 2`) tries to disconnect blocks without undo records and incorrectly flags corruption, preventing node restart.
